title: fix(rest): an undeclared hook abort answers the data door with HOOK_ABORTED
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziZEEbJZ3DUMwdVJWX

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBYEoqNTitmBCn1mkpaKyxVd)_

Fixes #27597

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (Error Handling, Declared refusals) teaches that a throw aborts and that a declared code rides `declaredCode`; it states no wire `code` for a free-text throw, so nothing it says turns false. `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` (Error Envelopes) teaches the ledger generically. The one published sentence this PR makes false, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx` ("a refusal that declared a status but no code arrives with `error` alone"), is corrected here.

**Proposed code: `HOOK_ABORTED`** (the maintainer names it at approval; the name lives in one ledger row, one constant `UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE`, two test files and one doc line):
- `HOOK_` is the domain prefix the ledger already uses for hook conditions (`HOOK_UNSCOPED_DATA_ACCESS`, `ERR_HOOK_TARGET_REBIND`), and `ABORTED` is the hook contract's own word (`onError: 'abort'`, the default), the shape of `BATCH_ABORTED`.
- It names what happened (a hook stopped the operation), not why; the why is the hook's own sentence in `error`.
- It is not a standard-catalog synonym: `standardSynonymOf('HOOK_ABORTED')` is `undefined` (no member carries `HOOK`), so it needs no waiver.
- Alternatives considered: `HOOK_REFUSED` (reads like a declared refusal, which is the `refusals` catalogue's job); `HOOK_UNDECLARED_REFUSAL` (names the author's omission rather than the event the client sees); the standard `VALIDATION_ERROR` that `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(400)` derives, which #24662 chose for an unevaluable hook condition. Rejected because the card asks for a code a client can tell apart from every other 400, and `VALIDATION_ERROR` is what any malformed body also answers.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：沙箱 hook 体用自由文本中止写入（`throw new Error('…')`，没声明 code、也没有 `refusals` 目录）时，`/data` 门现在回 `HOOK_ABORTED`；以前回的 400 没有 `code`。新码登记在 ADR-0112 台账 `@objectstack/types` 名下。
- 为什么改：这是 `/data` 门上唯一不带 `code` 的拒绝，控制台、SDK 和 AI 代理没法按 `code` 分支，分不清是 hook 有意中止还是别的未分类 400。
- 风险与回滚：`/data` 门是加宽，响应多一个 `code` 键，状态码和 `error` 文本不变；分享规则、安全建议绑定、审批和导入撤销这几个门对同一中止原来回通用的 `VALIDATION_ERROR`，现在也回 `HOOK_ABORTED`（改了已有值，请席位判断仍算 widening）；声明了 code 的拒绝（`refusals` 目录、注册码、降级到 `declaredCode` 的码）照旧，非 hook 的无码拒绝照旧不加码，崩溃仍是 500。回滚即还原本 PR。码名请在批准时定（默认 `HOOK_ABORTED`）。
- 先看：`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`（`sandboxRefusalCodeFields` 与两处调用），`packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`（声明状态透传分支），`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`（台账行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts`，应 12/12 全绿。
- 需要你做的：批准时确认码名 `HOOK_ABORTED`（或给出别名）。

## What changes

### Measured first, on `origin/main` `178b5238`

A sandboxed hook refusal with no declared code (the shape `quickjs-runner` throws: `.message` the `hook 'guard' threw: Error: boom abort` wrapper, `.innerMessage` `boom abort`, no `code`) answered every `/data` exit with no `code`:

- `mapDataError(err, 'obj')` → `400 {"error":"boom abort","object":"obj"}`
- `POST /data/:object`, `PATCH /data/:object/:id`, `POST /data/:object/batch` → the same, no `code`
- with `status: 422` or `statusCode: 422` → `422`, no `code`
- the wrapper fallback (instance lost, message only) → `400`, no `code`

How the door tells a declared refusal from an undeclared one today: by the error's own `code`. `thrownCodeFields` (via `resolveThrownHttpError`) answers `{}` when the producer declared no string `code`, and `{ code, declaredCode? }` otherwise. A hook with a `refusals` catalogue never reaches the door code-less: `resolveHookRefusal` turns a declared code into a `SandboxError` carrying `code` and `status`, and turns an undeclared or missing code into the sandbox's own fault (`500`). So "undeclared" at the door means: a sandboxed body's business refusal (`sandboxBusinessMessage` answers) whose `thrownCodeFields` is `{}`.

### The ledger row (spec)

`HOOK_ABORTED` under `@objectstack/types` in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER`, the package whose constant stamps it (the provenance gate reads a constant at its definition). `ErrorCode` and the generated reference pages (`content/docs/references/api/*.mdx`, `gen:docs`) pick it up. No `FieldErrorCode` change: this is a top-level code.

### The emitter (types, rest)

- `@objectstack/types`: `UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE = 'HOOK_ABORTED'`, typed `ErrorCode` so a ledger without the row stops the package compiling. `sandboxRefusalCodeFields(error, status)` returns `thrownCodeFields`' answer when the producer declared a code, else `{ code: UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE }`. `classifyDataError`'s sandbox unwrap door and its wrapper fallback read it.
- `@objectstack/rest`: `resolveErrorResponse`'s declared-status 4xx passthrough reads it when the error is a sandbox refusal (`businessMessage !== undefined`), so the `status` and `statusCode` spellings answer one code. Every other producer keeps `thrownCodeFields`.
- Not changed: the 5xx arms, the log verdict (`logUnexpectedRouteError`), the import runner's row codes (it adopts only `INVALID_FIELD`, `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `VALIDATION_FAILED` from the door).

### The same abort at the doors that re-dress this classification (measured by the existing suites)

The families that re-dress `/data`'s answer (`classifiedRefusalAnswer` → the nested envelope) already filled the missing code with the catalog floor for `400`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`. They now carry `HOOK_ABORTED` too, so one abort answers one code on every rest door that reads this classification:

| Door | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `/data` flat routes (POST, PATCH, DELETE, batch, createMany, updateMany, deleteMany, clone) | no `code` | `HOOK_ABORTED` |
| sharing rules (define, delete, evaluate), security suggested-bindings (confirm, dismiss, reopen), approvals (approve, reject, recall, revise, resubmit, reassign, remind, request-info, comment) | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `HOOK_ABORTED` |
| `/analytics/dataset/query` (its ①b arm asks `classifiedRefusalAnswer`) | no `code` | `HOOK_ABORTED` |
| `/data/:object/import/:jobId/undo` failures list | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `HOOK_ABORTED` |

The second and fourth rows move an existing value (`VALIDATION_ERROR` → `HOOK_ABORTED`) rather than adding a key, and the seat should weigh that against the claimed `(widening)` arm. Measured consumers: no `ui/**` or `@objectstack/client` code branches on `VALIDATION_ERROR` for these routes (the console renders `error`/`userMessage`; the client passes `code` through).

Client SDK: `@objectstack/client` carries no per-code mapping; it lifts the body's `code` string onto `err.code` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`, the `fetch` failure path), so `err.code === 'HOOK_ABORTED'` with no SDK change.

### Before and after

Before: `POST /api/v1/data/OBJ {"name":"throwabort"}` → `400 {"error":"boom abort","object":"OBJ"}`
After: `POST /api/v1/data/OBJ {"name":"throwabort"}` → `400 {"error":"boom abort","code":"HOOK_ABORTED","object":"OBJ"}`

### In-flight intersection with #27508 (log half, `domain:server`)

#27508's branch `claude/issue-27508-hook-abort-not-unhandled` @ `e9d789c2` (no PR yet) edits `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` in the log verdict (`isSandboxBodyRefusal`, `logUnexpectedRouteError`), lines this PR does not touch, so there is no textual conflict. There is a semantic one: its `isSandboxBodyRefusal` exempts the abort only when `resolved.body.code === undefined`, and after this PR the abort carries `HOOK_ABORTED`, so the abort would still be logged as `[REST] Unhandled error`. Whichever lands second makes that condition read the new code (for example `code === undefined || code === UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE`). Per the order, this PR does not touch the log half.

## Tests

- New `packages/rest/src/rest-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts` (12 cases): §1 `mapDataError` answers the code; §2 the POST, PATCH and batch routes; §3 a declared `status` / `statusCode` with no code keeps the status and gains the code, alike at both doors; §4 the wrapper fallback is byte-identical to the `innerMessage` door; §5 CONTROLS: a `refusals` catalogue answer keeps `declaredCode` beside `VALIDATION_ERROR`, a registered `RECORD_LOCKED` stays its own code, a non-sandbox 400 with no code still gets none, a crash is still `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`; §6 the ledger row is live (registered under `@objectstack/types`, parses as `ErrorCode`).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/hook-error-format.dogfood.test.ts`: the end-to-end pin that asserted `body.code` undefined for a free-text `throw new Error(...)` now asserts `HOOK_ABORTED`.
- Eleven existing rest suites pinned the old answer (29 cases: `code` absent on the flat door, `VALIDATION_ERROR` on the nested families and the undo list) and are flipped in the second commit, each with a `[#27597]` note: `rest.test.ts`, `rest-hook-refusal-code-parity`, `rest-hook-refusal-message-parity` (§8b), `rest-hook-script-fault-envelope`, `rest-sandbox-declared-status`, `rest-thrown-code-vocabulary` (the sandbox arm gains `undeclaredCode`), `rest-share-declared-code`, `rest-share-user-message`, `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger` (15 routes move to `HOOK_ABORTED_400`; package publish keeps `REFUSED_400`), `rest-declared-client-refusal-log` (still logs; only the code line moves), `import-undo-controls`. No declared-code case moved.

## Acceptance notes

- Doors that resolve through `resolveThrownHttpError` instead of this classification still answer the same abort with the status-derived `VALIDATION_ERROR`: `POST /api/v1/packages/publish` (pinned in `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`, unchanged) and the runtime dispatcher's exits (for example a hook abort relayed through an action body at `/actions`). Converging them means teaching `resolveThrownHttpError` the same rule, which moves the runtime door and its conformance suites; reported to the seat as a follow-up, not done here.
- An action body's refusal never reaches these doors (actions answer at the runtime `/actions` door). The wrapper fallback matches `action '…' threw:` too, and answers the same code, to stay byte-identical with the `innerMessage` door, which cannot tell the kind.
